# Contributing

Thanks for visiting my profile! If you want to contribute to any of the projects linked from this profile, please follow these guidelines:

- Open an issue to discuss bigger changes before sending a PR.
- Keep commits small and focused. Use clear commit messages.
- Include tests for bug fixes and features when possible.
- All code should adhere to the project's coding style and include documentation where helpful.

If you want me to highlight one of your forks or contributions here, open an issue in this repo and tag me.
